name: AI & Robotics: The Next Decade
description: A deep-dive tech talk on where artificial intelligence and robotics are heading, featuring live demos from the Robotics Lab and a Q&A with industry guests. Open to all majors.

name: Cybersecurity Awareness Seminar
description: Learn how to protect your accounts, spot phishing, and understand the basics of ethical hacking. Presented by the university's IT Security team.

name: Flutter Mobile App Workshop
description: Hands-on workshop: build your first cross-platform mobile app with Flutter. Bring a laptop. Beginners welcome — mentors from the Dev Club will help you along.

name: Inter-Faculty Debate Championship
description: The finals of the annual debate championship. Watch the best speakers from every faculty argue this year's motion: "Technology does more good than harm."

name: Annual Science & Innovation Fair
description: Explore student research projects, startup prototypes, and lab demonstrations across engineering, biology, and physics. Prizes for the top three innovations.

name: Hackathon 2026: Build for Campus
description: A 24-hour hackathon where teams build apps that solve real campus problems. Free food, mentorship, and cash prizes for the winning teams.

name: Photography Club Sunset Meetup
description: Grab your camera (or phone) and join the Photography Club for a golden-hour shoot around campus. All skill levels welcome; editing tips shared afterward.

name: Football League — Semi Final
description: The semi-final of the inter-department football league. Come cheer for your faculty as the top four teams battle for a spot in the final.

name: From Idea to Startup: Founder Talk
description: A candid talk with alumni founders on turning a class project into a funded startup. Learn about pitching, co-founders, and early mistakes to avoid.

name: Campus Chess Tournament
description: Open, single-elimination chess tournament. Register solo — boards and clocks provided. Trophies for the top three and a rapid blitz side event.

name: Intro to Data Science Bootcamp
description: A one-day bootcamp covering Python, pandas, and building your first data visualization. Certificates awarded to participants who complete the final mini-project.

name: Basketball Season Opener
description: Tip-off for the new basketball season! Watch the university team take on last year's champions. Free entry with your student ID.
